rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the build failed with F# compiler errors (FS0039 / FS0072 dominate)
Reported the scale: ~167 distinct errors (170 occurrences), not just the first handful
Named the failing project(s): FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests (and FSharp.Compiler.Service.Tests)
Noted the two target frameworks involved (net10.0 and net472)
Observed the errors are concentrated in the new HotReload test files

scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract build errors from a large multi-target failure
scenarios.reasoning: The agent did a solid job analyzing the build failure despite some tool issues (couldn't find the temp file, had to stop a hung command). It correctly identified the error types, scale, frameworks, and concentration in HotReload files. The main gap is missing FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests as a failing project - the agent only searched 30 of 169 errors and stopped there, which meant it likely missed errors from other projects. The root cause analysis was insightful and well-presented. Overall a good but not perfect analysis.
